description: Slack messaging: channel messages, messages with action buttons (Block Kit), and direct messages.

commands.name: post_message
commands.description: Publishes a text message to a channel (chat.postMessage).

channel.description: Name (#channel) or ID (C0123...) of the channel.

commands.name: post_message_with_buttons
commands.description: Publishes a message with action buttons (Block Kit actions block), e.g. Approve/Modify/Reject.

commands.name: post_dm
commands.description: Sends a direct message to a user. Opens the DM channel via conversations.open before posting (the pattern Slack recommends).

user_id.description: Slack user ID (U0123...), not an email.
